root_text:
🚨 HMPV virus case detected in Bengaluru in an 8 months old child.
 Now it is reportedly 10 cases till now
Symptoms:

- Cough
- Fever
- Runny or stuffy nose
- Sore throat
- Wheezing
- Shortness of breath (dyspnea).
- Rash
